title: Attendize through 2.8.0 contains a cross-account authorization bypass vulnerability in…
description: Attendize versions up to 2.8.0 have a cross-account authorization bypass vulnerability in the EventAttendeesController::postMessageAttendees() function. This flaw allows authenticated organisers to send messages to attendees of events they do not own by specifying a foreign event_id. Exploitation can lead to attackers sending arbitrary emails to other accounts' attendees, facilitating phishing and impersonation attacks. The vulnerability is fixed in version 2.8.1.
